query: If airlines eliminated the most common cabin-service complaints in the reviews, how much would the average Overall Rating improve?

per_column.name: primary_service_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: Identifies which cabin-service complaint dominates; the query's intervention is 'eliminating the most common cabin-service complaints', so this is the intervenable treatment lever - airlines can act to remove specific complaint categories.

per_column.name: complaint_frequency_pattern
per_column.rationale: Whether an issue is isolated vs recurring/systemic influences both which complaints arise (treatment) and how severely they depress ratings (outcome). Not named in query.

per_column.name: cabin_class
per_column.rationale: Travel class shapes both the type/likelihood of service complaints and baseline satisfaction/rating. It is a common cause not named in the query (Class exists in original table but not referenced in the query text).

per_column.name: aircraft_cabin_condition
per_column.rationale: Physical cabin condition affects both the occurrence of complaints (cleanliness, comfort) and the overall rating independently. Not named in query.

per_column.name: cabin_crew_service_tone
per_column.rationale: Crew tone is largely a manifestation of the service experience that lies on the causal path between service delivery and complaints/rating rather than a pre-treatment common cause; treated as mediator, not counted as confounder.

per_column.name: food_quality_consistency
per_column.rationale: Food quality is itself part of the service experience being complained about (a component of the treatment/mechanism), so it is a mediator rather than an independent confounder.

per_column.name: multi_complaint_pattern
per_column.rationale: Whether there are multiple vs single vs no complaints is downstream of both underlying service quality and rating dissatisfaction; it is an effect/summary of complaints rather than a common cause, closer to a collider/outcome-adjacent variable.

judge.rationale: The set correctly establishes an intervenable treatment: the dominant cabin-service complaint category is something airlines can act to eliminate, matching the what-if intervention in the query. Several columns provide genuine pre-treatment confounders not named in the query (cabin_class, aircraft_cabin_condition, complaint_frequency_pattern), which is the capability under test. However, several other added columns (cabin_crew_service_tone, food_quality_consistency, multi_complaint_pattern) are mediators or colliders on the service->complaint->rating path rather than common causes, so they do not strengthen the confounding-adjustment claim. Confounder coverage is moderate rather than strong.
